Chapter 127: Chapter 14: Ten Thousand Years (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 127: Chapter 14: Ten Thousand Years (Please Subscribe)

“`

Now in the Seventh Star Cave,

besides those three Red Pattern Examiners.

The least numerous are actually the Golden Pattern Challengers.

Those who occupy the majority are instead the Silver Patterns who came afterward.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted.

...

He looked toward the initial location where one is transferred from the Sixth Star Cave to the Seventh Star Cave.

A young man suddenly appeared, evidently having just passed through the Sixth Star Cave.

“Fang Qing?”

Lin Yuan immediately recognized the other person.

Early on during the previous star cave challenges, Lin Yuan had identified Fang Qing.

After all, Lin Yuan was quite familiar with Fang Qing; no matter how many times Fang Qing changed his appearance or altered his stature, Lin Yuan could easily recognize him.

“Indeed.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

It was no surprise to Lin Yuan that Fang Qing could make it to the Seventh Star Cave.

The challenge of the Seven Star Cave mainly lies in the word ‘challenge’. Fourth Rank Evolvers might have some advantages, but not much, and especially in the Seventh Star Cave, Fourth Rank Evolvers are actually at a disadvantage.

“Continue.”

“It’s almost over now.”

Lin Yuan no longer paid attention to Fang Qing and walked towards the stone statue in front of him.

…

“What a massive mountain.”

As soon as Fang Qing arrived at the Seventh Star Cave, he was immediately attracted by the mountain beneath his feet.

After all, a mountain standing in the middle of the cosmic starry skies is quite a rare sight, and other Evolvers seeing it for the first time would surely be shocked.

Lin Yuan, when he first arrived at the Seventh Star Cave, was also shocked by this mountain.

Soon.

Fang Qing’s attention shifted from the mountain to the many stone statues atop the summit.

“To comprehend the Evolution Path contained within the stone statues?”

Once Fang Qing understood the rules, he looked up at the summit again.

One hundred thirty-six stone statues came into sight and instinctively, Fang Qing was drawn to two of them.

“Those two.”

Fang Qing immediately walked towards the two stone statues.

…

Time passed.

Another three or four days went by.

Lin Yuan had already reached the last stone statue.

This statue was a huge mouth, thirteen to fourteen meters wide, as if it wanted to swallow everything.

“Swallowing?”

Lin Yuan was slightly stunned.

Under other statues, there were usually several Examiners comprehending them.

Especially those with simpler entry-level statues, there were even more than a dozen Examiners sitting cross-legged.

But not a single Challenger was before this strange statue.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to start his comprehension..

Buzz!

A faint spatial fluctuation came.

In the distance, below the colossal Rubik’s Cube, a silver-haired woman showed joy on her face and reached out to touch the cube.

Suddenly.

The Rubik’s Cube stopped spinning.

It radiated a soft glow.

The silver-haired woman disappeared.

This scene caught the attention of most Evolvers on the field.

After all, the silver-haired woman was one of only three Red Pattern Examiners among a million.

Moreover.

The silver-haired woman was also the first, who comprehended a stone statue over ten meters, and then passed the challenge as an Evolver.

…

In the Mysterious Space.

Twelve figures saw the silver-haired woman leave and immediately started talking.

“That’s the Everlasting Cosmic Evolution Path…”

“Just twenty-seven days to comprehend the First Tier Chapter, well nurtured, she might even surpass Sixth Rank in the future.”

“Too bad, such a genius has nothing to do with us.”

“What’s wrong? You want to take her in? Do you even understand the Everlasting Cosmic Evolution Path?”

…

The nine figures below casually chatted.

At this point, they no longer paid attention to Lin Yuan.

Twenty-three days, a whole twenty-three days.

While other Examiners labored in comprehension and gained a lot during those twenty-three days,

it all came to Lin Yuan, who just idly wandered for twenty-three days.

If it weren’t for the fact they had no authority to interfere with the trials, some would probably have gone to ask Lin Yuan what exactly he had been doing those twenty-three days.

…

“Lin Yuan…”

Among the three figures above, Gu Ze silently looked at Lin Yuan.

At that moment, Lin Yuan was sitting under the ‘Giant Mouth’ statue.

“The Swallowing Sky Evolution Path is not so easy to comprehend.”

Gu Ze still had a faint hope for Lin Yuan.

But this kind of faint hope had already appeared more than a hundred times.

…

Half a day later.

“Swallowing Sky Evolution Path…”

“Eat, eat, eat, devour everything, to fulfill oneself.”

“The cosmic starry sky, will become my sustenance…”

…

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and steadied himself.

He had to admit, this statue was truly strange; the Evolution Path it contained could actually affect one’s mind.

“I can draw lessons, but I cannot follow this path.”

Lin Yuan gazed at the ‘Giant Mouth’ statue before him.

The ‘Swallowing Sky’ Evolution Path discerned from the statue emphasized one key aspect: consumption.

To consume everything, planets, even galaxies.

Of course, following this Evolution Path to the end would lead to losing human form, with Spiritual Wisdom gradually diminishing.

…

“Finally done.”

“One hundred thirty-six stone statues, comprehended all.”

Lin Yuan was in good spirits; it was the first time he had seen so many Evolution Paths at once.

Each Evolution Path, Lin Yuan had only comprehended parts or even small parts of it, to comprehend as many Evolution Paths as possible, he almost gobbled them up whole.

As soon as he met the standard of comprehension, he would immediately turn to the next statue.

Of course, Lin Yuan’s ‘standard’ was the upper limit for other Challengers to pass this star cave.

“I should rest for a bit…”

Lin Yuan left the ‘Giant Mouth’ statue and sat down casually on a clearing at the top of the mountain.

Even with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, furiously comprehending statues, embracing Sixth Rank and beyond Evolution Paths for half a month had left Lin Yuan somewhat exhausted.

“It’s been twenty-three days, it’s time to pass.”

Lin Yuan braced himself with his right hand on the ground and glanced at the numerous statues.

It would be extremely simple for him to pass the Seventh Star Cave, just randomly choose a statue and then touch it with his hand.

The statue would naturally sense whether Lin Yuan’s body contained the trace of the Evolution Path it encompassed.
